entries.notes: All 19 executable TypeScript cases are translated. Coverage includes stream-reader setup, pre-aborted hydration, stream-delivered reasons and listeners, throw-if-aborted behavior, step-context stream writes, durable hook resume, synchronous local abort, post-context safety, multiple consumers, AbortSignal.any compatibility, fatal abort classification, retry suppression, and the production requirement that resumeHookDurable is queued in pre-completion work before step_completed. WF-RUST-027 records this cancellation ordering boundary. Final GREEN must use the real Rust serialization bridge, step context, stream backend, durable hook writer, and step executor.

All 22 executable TypeScript cases are translated. Coverage characterizes the dual hook/stream model across pre-aborted and late-aborted serialization, one-sided and two-sided transport failure, symbol identity, idempotent double abort, synchronous first-run listeners, replay listeners and durable reasons, cross-execution abort, fire-and-forget completion, and preservation of pending steps, hooks, and waits at suspension. WF-RUST-028 records the consistency and replay boundary. Final GREEN must exercise the production Rust serializer, event log, hook and stream transports, abort state machine, suspension collector, and replay scheduler.
